text: {"lessons":["Recent gains and losses have been volatile, and past price movements do not reliably predict what comes next.","Selling 20 shares of Stock A after a large gain reduced my exposure, but the later account decline does not show whether that was the right decision; I should follow a consistent plan rather than judge trades by short-term outcomes.","Since losses weigh heavily on me and I trade infrequently, I should keep risk at a level I can tolerate and avoid reacting impulsively to account fluctuations."]}
